description: Loka AI develops secure, explainable AI agents tailored for HR departments and recruiting companies, focusing on internal candidate search and automated CV screening.

founders_enriched.source_of_identity: Research and publications on Large Language Models (LLMs) and explainable AI.
Over ten years of experience in building and scaling B2B SaaS products.
13 years of experience in building and scaling SaaS businesses in the HR-Tech sector.
Conducted AI research at BMW Group Corporate R&D.

funding_summary: Received €25,000 in startup funding from AI+Munich Batch 8 in March 2024; finalist in the Munich Innovation Challenge 2024 in July 2024; secured second place in the BayStartUP competition in March 2025; accepted into the Spring 2025 batch of 'The Migrant Accelerator' in April 2025; awarded the EXIST Start-up Grant in February 2026.
inflection_why_now: The increasing demand for data privacy and compliance with regulations like the EU AI Act makes Loka AI's locally hosted AI solutions timely and essential.
devils_advocate_risks: Challenges in scaling AI solutions to meet diverse client needs.
Potential difficulties in integrating with existing HR systems and workflows.

lp_synergy_matches.reason: Loka AI's focus on secure, explainable AI agents for corporate HR aligns with SAP's enterprise solutions, potentially enhancing SAP SuccessFactors with advanced AI capabilities.
Evonik's interest in innovative technologies could complement Loka AI's AI-driven HR solutions, fostering advancements in talent management within the chemical industry.
